title: Login Issue
description: Customer cannot log in despite correct credentials, tried multiple devices and browsers. Workflow blocked, needs urgent check of authentication and server response.

title: Payment Failure
description: Valid credit card transaction declined without error message. Possible gateway integration, timeout, or bank verification issue causing customer frustration.

title: UI Bug
description: Dashboard buttons misaligned on smaller screens. Layout looks broken though functionality works. Responsive CSS rules need review.

title: Email Not Sent
description: Order confirmation email not received. Customer checked spam folders. SMTP configuration and email queue need investigation.

title: Slow Performance
description: Website loads slowly during peak hours. Customers face delays navigating and submitting forms. Possible server overload or heavy scripts.

title: Mobile App Crash
description: App crashes immediately on launch for several Android devices. Users cannot reach login screen. Crash logs need review.

title: Password Reset
description: Password reset link shows expired or invalid page. Users cannot regain access. Token expiration and reset URL need testing.

title: Search Error
description: Search feature fails to show complete results. Relevant data missing despite correct keywords. Backend query logic needs review.

title: Data Sync Issue
description: Updates on one device not appearing on another. Causes confusion and outdated info. Possible API sync or caching problem.

title: Notification Delay
description: Push notifications delivered minutes late instead of instantly. Time-sensitive alerts affected. Server queue or job scheduling issue suspected.

title: Broken Link
description: Help page link leads to missing page. Users cannot access support docs. Routing and deployment paths need correction.

title: Invoice Error
description: Invoice shows incorrect total compared to payment. Causes confusion and trust issues. Tax and discount logic need review.

title: Profile Update Issue
description: Profile changes not saved. Old data reappears after refresh. Possible API failure or validation error in update endpoint.

title: File Upload Error
description: Users cannot upload documents. Error shown after file selection. File size limits or server permissions may be cause.

title: Logout Problem
description: Logout button fails to end session. Account remains logged in after refresh. Session handling and token invalidation need review.
